title: `WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE` WAV files are not supported
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable.official, 4.5.beta5

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot v4.4.1.stable - Vulkan (Forward+)

### Issue description

Godot spawns errors when importing `WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE` WAV files:
```
ERROR: Format not supported for WAVE file (not PCM). Save WAVE files as uncompressed PCM or IEEE float instead.
ERROR: Can't save empty resource to path 'res://.godot/imported/DoesntWork.wav-5fb464281f6b9214ae48c1af0b5645fc.sample'.
ERROR: core/io/file_access.cpp:857 - Condition "f.is_null()" is true. Continuing.
ERROR: Cannot open file 'res://.godot/imported/DoesntWork.wav-5fb464281f6b9214ae48c1af0b5645fc.sample'.
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://.godot/imported/DoesntWork.wav-5fb464281f6b9214ae48c1af0b5645fc.sample. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://DoesntWork.wav. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
```
Errors when trying to assign such file to `AudioStreamPlayer`:
```
ERROR: Cannot open file 'res://.godot/imported/DoesntWork.wav-5fb464281f6b9214ae48c1af0b5645fc.sample'.
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://.godot/imported/DoesntWork.wav-5fb464281f6b9214ae48c1af0b5645fc.sample. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://DoesntWork.wav. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add `WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE` WAV file into your project
2. Check Output panel

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[GitHubMrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21685004/GitHubMrp.zip)

[example-short-sound.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21685036/example-short-sound.zip)
